summary: Verified new Toya AI concierge chatbot end-to-end. Backend POST /api/chat with real Emergent LLM (gpt-5.4-mini) tested for grounding (real service/product IDs), multi-turn context, hours query, empty-body 400, and hallucination prevention across all returned markdown links. Frontend ChatWidget tested for bottom-LEFT positioning (no FAB conflict), open/close, input send, user/assistant bubble render, RichText markdown->clickable button conversion, SPA navigation via react-router (clicking a rendered link closed the widget and navigated to /book), suggestion chips (chat-chip-book/find/hair/store) firing preset messages, typing indicator, and global mount on multiple pages. 6/6 backend chat tests PASS. 7/7 frontend chat flows PASS. No issues found.

backend_chat_tests.test_product_query_references_real_produ: PASS - wig query returned real /product/<id> from catalog
backend_chat_tests.test_no_hallucinated_links: PASS - every /product/<id> and /book?service=<id> link maps to a real DB id; other links are only /book, /shop, /, tel:, mailto:, http(s)://
backend_chat_tests.test_multi_turn_context: PASS - 'I want a wig' -> 'which is cheapest?' produced a wig-category product link, context retained

frontend_chat_tests.widget_position: chat-toggle at x=20 (bottom-LEFT); fab-whatsapp at x=1372 (right) - no overlap
frontend_chat_tests.panel_open_close: PASS - chat-panel appears on toggle click
frontend_chat_tests.send_flow: Input + chat-send -> user bubble + assistant reply (LLM ~5-8s)
frontend_chat_tests.internal_link_nav: 5 rendered link buttons; clicking 'book an appointment' navigated SPA to /book AND closed the panel (react-router navigate, no full reload)
frontend_chat_tests.suggestion_chips: chat-chip-book / -find / -hair / -store all present; clicking chat-chip-find sent preset and returned real assistant reply
frontend_chat_tests.typing_indicator: 3 bouncing dot spans render while awaiting LLM response

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat correctly injects live services & products from Mongo into system prompt each call, so LLM output is grounded on real catalog - grounding tests confirm zero hallucinated IDs across queries.
server.py chat only sends the last 9 messages of history to the LLM (history = req.messages[-9:]) - reasonable cap to control tokens; ChatWidget already trims to last 10 client-side.
Graceful fallback in /api/chat on LLM exception returns a helpful reply with /book, /shop links and phone number, instead of leaking a 500 to the client - good UX.

ChatWidget RichText parser handles [label](url) and **bold**; internal URLs (startsWith('/')) route via react-router navigate() and close the panel - matches the requirement to keep the SPA experience.

Positioning: chat button at fixed bottom-5 left-5 z-50 (bottom-LEFT) intentionally avoids the bottom-RIGHT FloatingActions cluster (WhatsApp/Directions/Call). Verified via bounding-box coordinates - no overlap.

Minor consideration (non-blocking): if req.messages contains an empty {content:''} as the last item, latest becomes '' but the LLM is still called; consider trimming empty trailing user messages server-side. Not exercised in normal UX because the client blocks empty sends.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 chat + prior 12/12 suite regression not re-run this iteration)

seed_data_creation: None - relied on existing service/product seeds (box-braids, knotless-braids, wig-install, afro-wig, lace-wig, curly-wig, hair-oil, etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New /api/chat endpoint uses real LLM (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, gpt-5.4-mini). Tests in /app/backend/tests/test_chat.py cross-check every returned markdown link against /api/services and /api/products to prevent hallucination regressions. Frontend widget is in global Layout so it renders on every non-admin route; chat-toggle sits bottom-LEFT (x~20) to avoid conflict with bottom-RIGHT FloatingActions (fab-whatsapp/directions/call at x~1372 on 1440-wide viewport).
